_about: Hand-entered showtimes, keyed by venue id (must be in web/venues.json and not a link-out venue). Required: title, start (Vancouver time with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-07T19:30:00-07:00; UTC-7 year-round from 2026-11-01), source_url (where you read it), added (date you typed it in). Optional: price (regular adult admission in CAD as the source states it; 0 = free), note. The page tags these "hand-entered" and hides each once it has started, so past entries can stay. Validated before every scrape and by the tests; see kinolocator/manual_listings.py.
